exposure: health status at birth (high-risk chronic conditions, prematurity)
cohort: The study included singletons aged 28 days to 4 years from Ontario (Canada), Scotland, and England, using linked administrative data from 2003-2013.
finding: Children born in the most deprived areas experienced the highest rates of RTI-related mortality across all three jurisdictions, and teenage motherhood was an independent risk factor for RTI-related mortality in Ontario, even after adjusting for health status at birth.
